details:
I use the buttons in nearly every crowded instance I am in to un-show people I've manually shown. They are useful to quickly scan through every single person in the instance. 

There are 2 solutions to this: 

1.) Put the the forwards/backwards buttons back in the Quick Menu.

2.) Add a "safety" page in the here menu that lets me easily reset the settings I have for **only the people actively in that instance**. (or even just a single button for it "Reset all shown avatars")

To be clear, adding a button to reset all safety settings across everyone on my account is **not** what this is for. (I believe you can already do this on the website)

The goal here is to reset the manually shown avatars in the instance. So far, the way I usually find fastest to do this is via those forward/backward buttons. That is the #2 thing I use the profile menu for, right after enabling people's avatars. It'd also be awesome to have it for non-friends or non-favorites but that's creepin the scope. 

I just want to be able to quickly see who I do/don't have manually shown in the instance, and quickly reset them to use safety settings. 

The functionality already exists, please consider adding the buttons back! And if it turns out the buttons are still there, let me put them at the top please!
title: New Look Quick Menu Profile removes the Forward/Backwards buttons
